title.de: Steuereinnahmen nach Ländern, vor und nach Verteilung
title.en: Tax receipts by Land, before and after distribution

basis: Cash receipts by Land, calendar year. 'Before distribution' = taxes collected in the Land (Aufkommen); 'after distribution' = what the Land, its municipalities, the Federation and the EU receive out of that Land's table after legal shares, equalisation and grants.
